planning_notes: Use control_period_ms=5ms as scheduling granularity; countdown decrement and the continuous 2-second buzzer window are handled in SysML using elapsed_ms (delta_since_previous_step).
Buttons: D2 and D3 are modeled as digital_input with model=true meaning the button is pressed. Electrical polarity/pullup are not specified, so catalog defaults are used.
TM1637 wiring is exactly CLK=D4 and DIO=D5. The display shows remaining seconds as a single integer without leading zeros; invalid_policy=blank hides the value when invalid per model rules.
No serial requirements were provided in the source text; therefore serial_channels is empty.
For the buzzer 'continuous鸣叫 2秒' behavior, SysML should enable tone_output for the required elapsed-time window; tone_output frequency selection is assumed to be defined in SysML.

interfaces.name: io_0
interfaces.meaning: Add 10-second increment request (button press model=true when pressed)

interfaces.name: io_1
interfaces.meaning: Start countdown request (button press model=true when pressed)

interfaces.name: io_2
interfaces.meaning: Buzzer drive frequency (SysML controls continuous 2-second tone window)

interfaces.name: io_3
interfaces.meaning: Remaining seconds display on TM1637 (countdown value in seconds)

configuration_resolution.original_requirement: 构建一个倒计时提醒系统，使用 TM1637（CLK=D4，DIO=D5）、按钮 D2、按钮 D3 和蜂鸣器 D6。D2 用于增加倒计时时间（每次加 10 秒），D3 用于开始倒计时；数码管显示剩余秒数，结束时蜂鸣器连续鸣叫 2 秒。
